thread:
sophie: Quick sync — final copy pass for the landing pages (Hosted API / Dedicated / Private). Need hero variants, the webinar hook blurb, and inbound form routing rules. Low-lift edits only, pls.

marta: +1. can we keep three short hero slabs (speed, predictability, control) and a single microcopy line that changes per mode?

gabe: Suggested microcopy: Hosted = 'Start in minutes. Predictable performance at any scale.' Dedicated = 'Reserved GPU pools, SLA-backed throughput.' Private = 'VPC & on‑prem options for regulated data.' Feels a bit formal — can shorten.

olivia: For webinar hook: 'Join our benchmark demo — reduce per-token cost with smart batching & caching.' Callout: include a concrete number in the webinar promo (e.g., "3x cost reduction in our benchmark") if we can validate.

patrick: On hero headlines, two short A/B candidates each mode:
- Hosted A: 'Production-ready inference, minutes to launch'
- Hosted B: 'Fastest path from model to product'
- Dedicated A: 'Throughput you can reserve, latency you can trust'
- Dedicated B: 'Committed capacity for predictable apps'
- Private A: 'Bring inference behind your network'
- Private B: 'Full control: VPC, KMS, audit logs'

ken: My pick: Hosted B, Dedicated A, Private B. Also recommend a one-line subhead under each hero that includes an outcome: speed (p50/p95), cost, compliance.

marta: Good call. For the subheads let's keep them outcome-driven and numeric where possible. Example: Hosted subhead = 'p50 < 50ms for common chat workloads' (need PM sign-off on numbers).

sophie: PMs — can you confirm latency/cost numbers by EOD? If not, we'll use qualitative phrasing: 'industry-leading latency' and 'predictable unit economics'.

gabe: For the webinar CTA, two lines to test in ads/email copy:
1) 'Live benchmark: latency, cost, and a live rollout demo.'
2) 'See how we route traffic to cheaper model variants without user-visible errors.'

olivia: Also want a micro-FAQ blurb beneath hero for Private customers: 'Supports HSM/KMS, audit logging, and air-gapped installs' — keeps legal/security leads happy.

patrick: Inbound form routing — proposed mapping (very small snippet to hand off to growth):

```
if form.interest == 'hosted' -> queue: sdr-hosted
if form.interest == 'dedicated' -> queue: sdr-dedicated
if form.interest == 'private' -> queue: sdr-enterprise
if utm_campaign contains 'webinar' -> tag: webinar-lead
```

ken: Add preference flags: 'needs-compliance-review' when interest==private and company_size>500.

marta: Good. Also add a hidden field on the webinar form: `benchmark_opt_in=true` so registrants automatically get the benchmark PDF after the event.

sophie: Copy localization note: For APAC we should avoid hard latency numbers in hero. Use qualitative for now.

gabe: Quick microcopy for feature bullets under hero (3 bullets):
- 'Smart batching & KV caching to cut unit costs'
- 'Multi-variant routing for graceful degradation'
- 'Per-token observability and rollout controls'

olivia: Love that. For the Dedicated page, reorder bullets to lead with 'reserved capacity' + 'SLA' then the optimizations.

patrick: Mock CTA text options (single button):
- 'Get started'
- 'See benchmarks'
- 'Request a pilot' (for Dedicated/Private)

ken: Suggest mapping buttons to funnels: Hosted -> 'Get started' (signup), Dedicated -> 'Request a pilot' (sales lead), Private -> 'Request a demo' + form with compliance checklist.

marta: Next steps / owners:
- finalize hero headlines (marketing) — marta (done by tomorrow)
- confirm numbers (PMs) — ken to chase
- implement routing snippet in Growth forms — patrick / growth ops
- update Dedicated bullets/order — gabe
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: copy-pass/marketing-hero → staging at 2024-10-15T18:00Z :white_check_mark:

sophie: Awesome — I'll assemble the copy doc and push a single PR to the site repo with the three hero slabs + webinar blurb + routing snippet. Tagging @marta @patrick for final review before PR. :thumbsup:
